_about: The catalog: every thing the player can own, with its picture, its price and at most one effect. `key` is needed by an exit; a pill pays `progress` on use from a capped table; `wear` puts it on Yinyue (with a `lift`: her card's atk or hp by 1, or her 疗伤 by 0.1) or the abode; `charm` is a 符 — one in the bag is its card (cards.json, the same id) in hand at a fight's door, spent when it is played. Arms are the fight's own: a weapon's `atk` (器攻) with the `root` it lends, a 法衣's `def` (防), a 佩's `ward` (抗, by element) — each worn in its own slot, and each turned into the fight's numbers at the door by the rates in cards.json `gear` (器攻 → 主灵根一击, 防 → 护体, 抗 → that element lands lighter; the root lent lets its 功法 into the deck). `temper` feeds a 本命法宝 that many points of growth, and `core` on such a material names the element it would lend if the treasure were bound with it. `sold` names the provinces whose market shelves it; an item sold nowhere is a gift or a drop only. `pouch` on a 储物袋 adds that many slots to the bag's room for good, once for each kind (rewards.json `pouch`).
_juan: The 卷 a thing belongs to (Hanli, 2026-10-05: 不要有后面各卷的物品): `juan`, 1 unsaid. One of a 卷 not open is never shelved, found, dropped or paid by a 传闻 (world.mjs ofJuan): 固基丹, 破境丹, 望气术·下卷 and four of the 五天材 are 结丹's (卷二; 息壤 is 卷一's, from the 秘境), the provinces' goods wait for their 卷.
_rarities: 刷副本 (2026-10-15): a dropped arm's `rarity` (rewards.json drop_tables pick a rarity, then an arm of it) and the word the page and Ling say for it. The bonus stays small: 普通 器攻 1 / 防 1 / 抗土 1, 精良 2 / 2 / 抗土 2, 稀有 器攻 3 / 抗土 2+水 2 (no rare 法衣: 防 3 took the stair's 犰狳 from ~50% to ~80%; no wood ward at all), through the same rates as any arm (cards.json gear).

about.zh: 山中所生，灵兽所喜。
about.en: Grows in the hills; spirit beasts love it.

about.zh: 一粒抵半日打坐。
about.en: One pill is worth half a day's sitting.

hint.en: One pill, half a day.

about.zh: 形如人，年久者有灵。
about.en: Shaped like a person; an old one has a spirit of its own.

about.zh: 练气者的第一把剑，斩不了妖，斩得了心。佩之借木。
about.en: A first sword: it cuts no demon, only doubt. Worn, it lends 木.

about.zh: 泗水多雨。编得厚实，挡得住一拳。
about.en: It rains often on the Si. Woven thick, it turns a blow.

about.zh: 沉鼎观弟子的粗布袍，入门那天发的。
about.en: The coarse robe of a Sunken Cauldron Abbey disciple, given on the day of entry.

about.zh: 一袋干饼，硬得能砸核桃。货郎担子上、客栈柜上论袋卖，渡叔那样的人也爱往你手里塞一袋。
about.en: A bag of flat cakes, hard enough to crack walnuts. Pedlars and inns sell them by the bag, and people like Du Shu will press one on you.

hint.en: Chew slowly.

about.zh: 汉墓里出来的东西，握着微温。
about.en: Something from a Han tomb; faintly warm in the hand.

about.zh: 船家只认牌，不认人。
about.en: The boatman knows the token, not the face.

about.zh: 系在银月颈上，走路便有声。
about.en: Tied at Yinyue's neck, it rings as she walks.

about.zh: 邺城铁匠打的，燕赵的样式。佩之借金。
about.en: Forged in Ye, in the style of Yan and Zhao. Worn, it lends 金.

items._sold: Never on a shelf (2026-10-03, the book: 全观一年一颗, the 宗门大比 champion's prize — 祁长松's in 古六, the hero's only at the year-five 大比 in 古八's skip, 09-dabi `dabi` — 古七's skip before the 2026-10-07 split): a gift or the sect's, not the market's. 一转下品 — one line, a few dark flecks.

about.zh: 练气九层圆满者冲关时服之，多几分把握。一转下品，一道纹，几点黑斑——全观一年只这一颗。
about.en: Taken at the Consummation of Qi Condensation, it steadies the breakthrough a little. One-turn, low grade: one ring, a few dark flecks — the whole temple gets one a year.

items._furnace: Made in 银月's furnace: one pill, from a 萝卜 at the end of 古五 (Hanli 2026-10-06: 「改成一颗」), never shown again until the eve of his 筑基 (Hanli 2026-10-06: 「等筑基的时候再拿出来」 — the bag gets it on 09-qulao `listen`) and eaten there (古八; 古七 before the 2026-10-07 split). The breakthrough reaches for it before the 一转 (ladder.json breakthrough.pill); not sold.
items._fill: `fill`: how far a breakthrough this pill carries fills the step it lands on — "full" lands it 圆满 (ladder.json `full`). The 九转 takes 小满 to 筑基小成圆满 in one night; the rest of its power sinks into the lake bed (古八, Hanli 2026-10-14: 「因为9转筑基丹, 小成得以圆满」). A pill without it lands at the step's start, 修为 0. Read by rules/core.mjs landFill; an exit may declare the same for a world with no breakthrough pills.

about.zh: 饭桶一炉出的筑基丹，透亮得像一滴凝住的露水，九道金纹，一丝黑斑也没有，一个字也没有。沉鼎观三百年最好的一炉是三转。
about.en: A foundation pill from the rice-tub furnace: clear as a drop of frozen dew, nine gold rings, not one dark fleck, not one word on it. The best batch the temple made in three hundred years was three-turn.

about.zh: 筑基者服之，根基愈固，结丹之路愈近。
about.en: For one who has laid the Foundation: the base grows firmer, the Core comes nearer.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-15, from the description.

about.zh: 结丹以后破境时带在身上，雷落下来多一分把握。破境时化去。
about.en: Carried into a breakthrough from the Core on, it steadies you under the lightning. It is spent in the attempt.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-28, seed 2809, 640×480: a cracked vermilion pill on a celadon dish, lightning inside it, thunder clouds.

about.zh: 旧时疗伤的丹，如今只剩市价。
about.en: A healing pill of older days; now worth only its price.

hint.en: Spring returns.

items._furnace: Made in 银月's furnace (story/jiuding-lu/DESIGN.md § 丹药等级 — 随主人: the owner's realm, 九转): its own item, never the market's 回春丹. `zhuan` draws its nine gold lines; not sold, and worth nothing at a counter (九转丹不能卖).

about.zh: 小铜炉里出来的回春丹。药铺柜台上的是一转，一道纹；它九道，金的。骨伤也治得好，修为也跟着涨一截。拿出去卖，没人认得——认得的，更坏。
about.en: A mending pill out of the little furnace. The one on the shop counter is one-turn, one ring; this has nine, in gold. It mends even broken bone, and your cultivation climbs with it. Nobody would know it at a counter — and whoever did would be worse.

items._furnace: Made in 银月's furnace from the garden's culls (xu-yaoyuan-canzhu): 九转, three times the market 聚气丹's 修为; not sold.

about.zh: 残株炼的聚气丹，出炉九道金纹。坊市的聚气丹抵半日打坐；它抵三日。
about.en: A qi-gathering pill from the garden's culls, nine gold rings on it. The market's is worth half a day's sitting; this, three days.

about.zh: 观妖之气，知其将攻将守。筑基可习。
about.en: Read a beast's qi: whether it means to strike or to hold. From the Foundation.

about.zh: 气之所向，一招一式皆可见。结丹可习，须先通上卷。
about.en: Where its qi goes, every move is seen. From the Core, after Part One.

about.zh: 濮阳桑门的纸，写符最好。
about.en: Paper from Puyang's Mulberry Gate; the best for writing talismans.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-15, from the description.

about.zh: 齐有渔盐之利。海边晒出来的盐，雪一样白。
about.en: Qi's wealth is fish and salt: sea salt dried on the shore, white as snow.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-16, from the description.

about.zh: 齐纨鲁缟，天下第一。披在银月肩上。
about.en: The silk of Qi, the finest under heaven; laid over Yinyue's shoulders.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-16, from the description.

about.zh: 桑皮纸上朱砂一道。降妖时在手，掷出打三点，不论五行；一符一用。
about.en: One stroke of cinnabar on mulberry paper. In hand when you fight: cast, it strikes for 3 whatever the root; one use each.

hint.en: One throw, and done.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-16, from the description.

about.zh: 银月从尾巴尖上拔下一根银毛，丢进饭桶，「本王给你开个张」——飘出来一张黄纸：朱砂画的一匹马，脑袋大，身子小，四条腿像四根筷子插在一个馒头上。你骂了一句「这踏马的，是什么符？」，符角一行米粒大的朱字答你：踏马符。底下一行更小：足下一踏，马上便走。叠成小方块，塞在腰带夹层里。只灵一回。
about.en: Yinyue plucked one silver hair from the tip of her tail and dropped it into the Rice Bucket — "Let this queen open shop for you" — and out floated a slip of yellow paper: a horse in cinnabar, big head, small body, four legs like four chopsticks stuck in a steamed bun. You swore at it — "What the hoof is this charm?" — and a line of rice-grain cinnabar in the corner answered: Hell-for-Leather Charm. Under it, smaller still: One stamp underfoot, and off at once. Folded small, tucked into your belt fold. Good once.

hint.en: One stamp underfoot, and off at once.

items._about: 古四 (the author, 2026-10-02): the 饭桶 spat it out for one of 银月's tail hairs; he never tried it, kept it in his belt fold, and slapped it on blind in 古五 (「这个用完就没了，留在秘境里用。」). One use, never sold; granted on the way to the 困阵 (wm-wangzuo open). Its card (cards.json tama-fu) summons the 蛫 as a 护主 — the existing answer to a 杀招 (battle.js § gather: the blow takes the guard first), which is the book's leap: the four fire snakes hit the shell (「是可以禦火」).
items.art_source: The talisman's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-16) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 小狰换下来的一撮红毛，喂进饭桶，吸你一口灵气，飘出一张黄纸：朱砂画一只鼻子，鼻孔朝天，两个鼻孔比鼻子还大。符脚一行小字：一缕清气，通窍。一张，一回。
about.en: A pinch of the zheng's moulted red fur, fed to the Rice Bucket for a mouthful of your qi: out floats a yellow slip with a nose drawn on it in cinnabar, nostrils to the sky, the nostrils bigger than the nose. Small print at its foot: A wisp of clear air, to open the passages. One slip, one go.

hint.en: A wisp of clear air, to open the passages.

items._about: 古六 (Hanli 2026-10-06): the 开炉夜 of 腊月初七 — broke, he feeds the 饭桶 凡物 and each feeding sucks a mouthful of his 灵气; granted at wm-qianye/sleep. A story thing: no slot, never sold. Used in bout one (Hanli 2026-10-06): woken, its black smoke shoots into 何七's nose and mouth; mid-sneeze he is pushed off; the slip goes to ash.
items.art_source: The talisman's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-16) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 小狰的一根胡子换来的三根针，细得像牛毛，针尖一点绿，并排插在一张小红纸片上。纸片上印着：痒痒针；底下一行小字：一针见笑。凡铁的东西，打不进比你高得多的人的护体灵光。
about.en: Three needles for one of the zheng's whiskers, fine as ox-hair, a dot of green at each tip, stuck side by side in a little red card. Printed on the card: Tickle Needles; and a line of small print: One prick, one laugh. Common iron: it won't get through the guarding light of someone far above you.

hint.en: One prick, one laugh.

items._about: 古六 (Hanli 2026-10-06): the 开炉夜 of 腊月初七 — broke, he feeds the 饭桶 凡物 and each feeding sucks a mouthful of his 灵气; granted at wm-qianye/sleep. A story thing: no slot, never sold. Touched and let go against 秦雁; thrown in the final, they glance off 祁长松's 护体灵光 and one finds an inner-court senior in the crowd.
items.art_source: The iron sword's picture until its own is painted.

about.zh: 伙房大娘扔掉的一面裂手镜，喂进饭桶，吐出来一面巴掌大的铜镜，缺一个角。谁拿起来照，照出来的都是你的脸；烛光打上去，原样弹回来。背面刻着三个字：自拍镜；底下一行小字：照人，先照己。
about.en: A cracked hand-mirror the kitchen auntie threw out, fed to the Rice Bucket: out came a palm-sized bronze mirror with a corner chipped off. Whoever looks into it sees your face; candlelight bounces straight off it. Carved on the back: Selfie Mirror; and a line of small print: Before it shows another, it shows you.

hint.en: Before it shows another, it shows you.

items._about: 古六 (Hanli 2026-10-06): the 开炉夜 of 腊月初七 — broke, he feeds the 饭桶 凡物 and each feeding sucks a mouthful of his 灵气; granted at wm-qianye/sleep. A story thing: no slot, never sold. In the semifinal it throws 马小宝's beam back into his own face — it brands his blotches white (Hanli 2026-10-06) — and shatters; he keeps the shards, and in 古九 the biggest one throws 老井's beam back.
items.art_source: The jade ring's picture until its own is painted.

about.zh: 一只小陶罐，牛油花椒味，罐上歪歪扭扭四个字：牛脂甘露；底下一行小字：麻辣鲜香。十月里喂一根伙房熬汤剩下的牛骨头换来的；银月说是火锅底料，说了两个月。
about.en: A little clay jar that smells of beef tallow and Sichuan pepper, four crooked characters on it — Beef-Tallow Nectar — and under them a line of small ones: Hot, numbing, fragrant. Traded in the tenth month for a beef bone left over from the kitchen's soup; Yinyue has been calling it hotpot base for two months.

hint.en: Numbing, hot, fresh, fragrant.

items._about: 古四 (the 饭桶's first feeding: 一根牛骨头 → 牛脂甘露); 古六 (Hanli 2026-10-06): in the 卢方 bout (Hanli 2026-10-06), hanging off the rim, he flings out whatever his hand finds in the 储物袋 — this jar; it breaks on the stone and 卢方's stamp skates off the stage on the tallow; that night two soup bones give a 鸳鸯 base. Granted at wm-qianye/sleep, where he takes it out from under the woodpile. A story thing: no slot, never sold.
items.art_source: The qi salt's picture until its own is painted.

about.zh: 山骨之精，千年始凝。
about.en: The mountain's own bone, a thousand years in the setting.

about.zh: 为雷所击而不死之木，纹里带火。
about.en: Wood the lightning struck and did not kill; the grain still carries fire.

about.zh: 触之如冰，暑月不温。
about.en: Cold to the hand, and no summer warms it.

about.zh: 地火烧尽余下的一点，落水不熄。
about.en: What is left when the earth-fire burns out; water does not put it out.

about.zh: 鲧窃帝之息壤以堙洪水——取之一掬，自生不已。
about.en: The soil Gun stole from the Emperor to dam the flood: a handful of it grows and does not stop.

about.zh: 寻常妖兽腹中所结，暖如活物。
about.en: Formed in an ordinary beast's belly; it is warm, like something living.

about.zh: 气已凝而不散，握之微微跳。
about.en: The breath in it holds together now; it beats faintly in the hand.

about.zh: 内有一线光行走不停。
about.en: A thread of light walks inside it and never stops.

about.zh: 缺口的环，古人佩以决事。土气厚，挡得住土行法术。
about.en: A ring with a gap, worn by the ancients when a thing had to be decided. Its earth is thick enough to turn an earth spell.

about.zh: 扬州厥包橘柚。淮南的橘，过了淮就成了枳。
about.en: Yang sent oranges and pomelos in baskets as tribute. An orange of the south turns bitter north of the Huai.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-24, from the description.

about.zh: 荆州贡丹。红得像火，炼丹的人离不开它。
about.en: Jing sent cinnabar as tribute. Red as fire; no alchemist can do without it.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-24, from the description.

about.zh: 蜀地的锦，要在锦江里洗，颜色才鲜。
about.en: The brocade of Shu; washed in the Brocade River its colours come up bright, and in any other river they dull.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-24, from the description.

about.zh: 雍州厥贡球、琳、琅玕。琅玕是青绿色的美石，圆得像珠子。
about.en: Yong's tribute was qiu and lin jade and langgan — a blue-green stone, round as pearls.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-24, from the description.

about.zh: 靛青绸面，绣着云纹。换上它，储物袋多出十二格。
about.en: Indigo silk worked with clouds. Carry it and your pouch holds twelve more kinds.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-25, from the description.

about.zh: 绛红织锦，玉扣系口，袋里自成一方天地。换上它，储物袋多出二十四格。
about.en: Crimson brocade with a jade toggle; a small world inside. Carry it and your pouch holds twenty-four more kinds.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-25, from the description.

about.zh: 灰布袋子，口上一道绳。主人死了，袋上的印记散了，到你手里便开。换上它，储物袋多出六格。
about.en: A grey cloth bag with a drawstring. Its owner is dead and the mark on it has faded, so it opens to your hand. Carry it and your pouch holds six more kinds.

items._about: 古五: off 邹青松 (赤松观), 杀人必摸尸 (design.md § Items) — the foe-zou win drops it. Smaller than 中品 (+12).
items.art_source: The middle-grade pouch's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-25) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 赤松观的火葫芦，葫芦口放得出火蛇。塞子是你一箭射下来的，从干了的暗河里捡回来塞上。空了。是赤松观的东西：山上，有赤松观的人在的地方，不能亮。
about.en: Red Pine Abbey's fire gourd; fire snakes pour from its mouth. The cork is the one your arrow shot off, picked up from the dry underground river and pushed back in. Empty now. It is Red Pine Abbey's: on the mountain, or anywhere their people are, it cannot be shown.

items._about: 古五: 邹青松's gourd, seen in the fight (火蛇) — 摸到的兵器，须是打斗里亮过相的 (design.md § Items). Worn, it lends fire; the win that drops it deals 火鸦 (creatures.json foe-zou `card`), its fire snakes as a card. Never sold. In the book (古七, Hanli 2026-10-06) he tosses it into the 饭桶 with the shield shards to be rid of them, and out comes a plain sword, 火柴 (huochai-jian).
items.art_source: The fire essence's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B)) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 赤铜葫芦连七八瓣盾片，你扔进饭桶图个干净，它吸了你五口气，吐出这一口：三尺来长，剑身暗红，火纹一道也没有了，剑脊上一溜锤印，像铁匠铺学徒打坏的。最寻常的法器。剑脊近柄刻着两个字：火柴；底下一行小字：剑起火升，攻守兼备。
about.en: The red-copper gourd and seven or eight shield shards, tossed into the Rice Bucket just to be rid of them; it took five mouthfuls of your qi and out came this: three feet or so, the blade a dull red with not one line of the fire pattern left, a row of hammer marks down the spine like an apprentice's botched piece. The commonest kind of artifact. Cut into the spine near the hilt: Matchstick; and a line of small ones: The sword rises, the fire climbs; attack and guard in one.

hint.en: The sword rises, the fire climbs; attack and guard in one.

items._about: 古七 (Hanli 2026-10-06): the day after the 大比 he moves into the 内门西廊; sorting the bag, the 赤松观 gourd and shield shards are rubbish — he tosses them into the 饭桶 wanting nothing (要什么，不出什么) and it gives a plain sword, already under his bunk when 瞿老 gives him the 《河洛剑诀》. The label names it (火柴; 小字「剑起火升，攻守兼备」). It carries both its sources, and NOTHING is shown in 卷一 (Hanli 2026-10-06): a strike (划) looses fire, then fire snakes like the gourd's — revealed at its first real fight; held flat (横) the copper of the spine spreads into a red shield of light, like 邹青松's 赤铜盾 — a later second surprise. Both draw on the holder's own 灵力 and scale with his level (finger-thin snakes early; the shield stops equals, not someone three layers up). It cannot cut a 七层's 护体灵光 (屠七); in 古八 (古七 before the 2026-10-07 split) it kills the 合窳 only as a sword, through the throat as it cries. Fire-attribute (root fire; stats otherwise unchanged). Granted at 09-snow/feed. Never sold. In the game the gourd stays in the bag (a worn weapon is never taken).
items.art_source: The iron sword's picture until its own is painted.

about.zh: 一双丑鞋：灰褐色的矮靿靴子，鱼鳞的纹路一片一片还在皮面上，两只脚后跟上各开一道缝，像鱼鳃。鞋底上烙着三个字：顺风溜；底下一行米粒大的小字：「背后有风，脚下有路。」
about.en: An ugly pair: grey-brown low boots, the fish-scale grain still on the leather, a slit on each heel like a gill. Burned into the sole: Tailwind; and beneath, in letters the size of rice grains: "Wind at your back, a road at your feet."

hint.en: Wind at your back, a road at your feet.

items._about: 古七 (Hanli 2026-10-09: 「小满自己做鞋子吗？……这之前都扔饭桶吧」; replaces the 2026-10-07 器房/老铁头 forging): the 鯥 of 沂水东岸 leaves its hide and gliding membrane; a winter stinking up the woodshed, then 年五开春 he feeds them to the 饭桶, which spits out the boots — name and one vague line on the sole (饭桶 item rule); the effect is found by trying: one step back with the wind, a ten-丈 glide downwind; against the wind only 「噗」. 银月, first words after a winter asleep: 「鱼皮鞋。还带响的。」 A 法器 for running, not fighting; three glides drain a 六层; the heel gills go 「噗」 so no sneaking. Used once more in 卷一: off the 黑松岭 cliff after the 合窳 throws him, downwind, three glides to the glowing grass. Game: worn in the 法衣 slot for a modest 防 +1 (the schema has no running effect); not granted by a scene yet, never sold.
items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (tools/paint-codex.py), 2026-10-07, from the description.

about.zh: 贴身藏着，一身的气敛进去，旁人看你，看低一两层。一道一回。
about.en: Kept against the skin, it draws your aura in; whoever looks you over reads you a layer or two lower. One use each.

hint.en: Keep your head down.

items._about: 古五: two off 邹青松. A story charm: no fight card, no effect in play yet (the 藏 arc uses them in the book: one at the 秘境 exit / before a probe, one kept — OUTLINE 扣子簿).
items.art_source: The talisman's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-16) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 灵草园里拔的，根上缠着阿禾那根红线，土还是园里的土。不是你的，带回去还她。
about.en: Pulled from the spirit-herb garden; Ahe's red thread is still round its root, the soil still the garden's. It isn't yours: you carry it back to her.

items._about: 古五: 邹青松 took it off 阿禾 at the dry underground river; 小满 finds it in his pouch and returns it in 古六. A story thing (`story`): no slot, never sold.
items.art_source: The lingzhi's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B)) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 邹青松自己攒的，袋口红绳扎了三道死结。二十三块灵石，一颗中品，碧透，里头一缕光自己在转。你数回袋里，扎好。
about.en: Zou Qingsong's own savings, the mouth tied with red cord in three dead knots. Twenty-three spirit stones and one of middle grade, clear green, a wisp of light turning inside it. You counted them back in and tied it up.

items._about: 古五 (Hanli 2026-10-05「丰厚一点」— a layer nine carries more): in the book (Hanli 2026-10-06) the whole purse, 中品 too, goes into the 饭桶 at 古五's end (「想出仙品，得喂仙品」) and nothing comes out. A story thing: no slot, never sold, adds no wealth.
items.art_source: The middle-grade pouch's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-25) until its own is painted.

name.en: The inner court's map of the realm

about.zh: 潭里那个九层身上的，石坎底下那一层画得明明白白——阿禾那张亲传的图上，那一层是空白。内门的东西，藏好。
about.en: Off the ninth-layer man in the pool: the level under the stone sill drawn plain — on Ahe's map, the Abbot's disciple's map, that level is blank. An inner-court thing; keep it hidden.

items._about: 古五 (2026-10-03, 穷人家的孩子，见了宝，都拿走): he searched the dead 九层 in the 蛫 pool — 聚气丹 ×5 and this map; the 名牌 and the cloud-pattern pouch went into the dark. A 扣子 for the next time the 秘境 opens (OUTLINE 扣子簿). A story thing: no slot, never sold.
items.art_source: The scroll's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B)) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 吴婆婆塞给你的小木牌，磨得发亮；刻着一只蜷着的狐狸，尾巴绕着身子——九条。银月睡在里头：一条尾巴亮着，银的，一明，一暗。
about.en: The little wooden token Granny Wu pressed into your hand, worn bright; carved with a curled fox, its tails wrapped round it — nine. Yinyue sleeps inside: one tail is lit, silver, bright then dim.

about.zh: 黑松岭那头雄鹿的皮，完整，油光水滑——够交马家的租。
about.en: The hide of the stag from Black Pine Ridge, whole and glossy — enough for the Mas' rent.

about.zh: 弓背裂过两回，拿牛筋缠着。爹摘下来放在你面前：「你拿着。」佩之借木。
about.en: Its back cracked twice and bound with ox sinew. Father took it off the wall and laid it before you: "Take it." Worn, it lends 木.

about.zh: 凡铁，刀口缺了两个牙，后来又缺了一个。秘境那道干了的暗河里，从一个死人手里一根一根掰开指头拿下来的。猎户放血，就使这么一把。
about.en: Common iron, two nicks in the edge, and later a third. Taken in the hidden realm's dry underground river from a dead man's hand, one stiff finger at a time. A hunter bleeds a deer with a knife like this.

items._about: 古五: picked up, not given (the author, 2026-10-02: 「在秘境中捡一把武器吧」). The lowest blade there is: 器攻 1.
items.art_source: The iron sword's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B)) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 只长在站过鼎的地方：鼎在那里站了上千年，地面泡透了鼎气，长出一层青得发黑的苔。筑基丹的主药；生吃，筑基多一分把握。天下只有鼎址才有。
about.en: It grows only where a cauldron once stood: a thousand years of standing soaks the ground with the cauldron's breath, and a moss comes up so green it is nearly black. The chief herb of the Foundation pill; eaten raw, it steadies a Foundation breakthrough a little. Only a cauldron's old footing grows it.

items._about: 古五 (the author, 2026-10-02): the 秘境's own — round the four 七拃 pits in the stone chamber, and in the cracks of the dry underground river below the wind shaft, where the cauldron's breath seeped down. Every one of the nine cauldrons' old footings will have it (OUTLINE 扣子簿). No effect of its own: carried into the Foundation breakthrough it is the last thing reached for (ladder.json breakthrough.pill), a small bonus.
items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-10-05: one square footing pit in the stone chamber floor, its rim ringed with blackish-green moss.

about.zh: 秦始皇派人在泗水捞鼎，水里钻出一条龙，咬断了绳子，崩掉几根龙须，落在河底扎了根。须子又长又硬，泛一点金。只长在泗水底下。吃下去，冲得开经脉。
about.en: When the First Emperor's men fished the Si for the cauldron, a dragon rose and bit the rope through, and a few whiskers snapped off, sank, and took root in the riverbed. Long, stiff blades with a gleam of gold. It grows only under the Si. Eaten, it forces the meridians open.

items._about: 古五 (the author, 2026-10-02; 《史记·封禅书》「龙髯拔，堕」, 鲁泥鳅's rope): only in the 秘境's dry underground river, bared the year the Si fell lowest. 冲开经脉 → 修为, the 筑基丹's own table (task).
items.art_source: The ginseng's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B)) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 秘境十年翻一回身，吸一口气；那口气在最深处凝成珠子，指甲盖大，攥在手心里一跳一跳，像攥着一颗心。跟息壤同出一源。吞一颗，修为涨一截。
about.en: Once in ten years the hidden realm turns over and draws one breath; in its deepest place that breath sets into a bead the size of a fingernail, which beats in the palm like a held heart. Of one source with the living soil. Swallow one, and your cultivation climbs a stretch.

items._about: 古五 (the author, 2026-10-02): 「河底下有东西在呼吸」 made a thing — 冯九 shows one at the door (「息珠。十年一口气，就凝这么几粒」). The 九转回春丹's table (scene).
items.art_source: The langgan's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-24) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 秘境暗河崖壁上的一道铜矿，往年淹在水底下。九鼎是收九州之铜铸的。
about.en: From a copper vein in the wall of the hidden realm's underground river, under water in other years. The nine cauldrons were cast from the copper of the nine provinces.

items._about: 古五 (the author, 2026-10-02): the year's low water bared a copper vein; 孙二狗 dug half a lump with his fingernails. A find at shimen (meets.json).
items.art_source: The true gold's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B)) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 银月留下的一卷残简，绳子都快烂了。「看不懂，也要背。背熟了，总有一天会懂。」
about.en: The scroll Yinyue left, its cords nearly rotted through. "Learn it by heart even if you can't understand it. One day you will."

about.zh: 伙房的萝卜，白的，带着泥。银月说：带根萝卜去。
about.en: A radish from the kitchen, white, with the soil still on. Yinyue said: take a radish.

about.zh: 银月从仙界带下来的丹炉，巴掌大，三足两耳，炉盖上蹲着一只小兽。它炼丹不炸。它嘴刁。
about.en: The furnace Yinyue brought down from the heavens: palm-sized, three legs, two ears, a little beast crouched on the lid. It never blows up a batch. It is a picky eater.

about.zh: 瞿老扔给你的一卷薄书。「上有黄庭下关元，后有幽阙前命门」——三丹田，这回自己练。
about.en: A thin book Elder Qu tossed you. "Above is the Yellow Court, below the Origin Pass; behind the Hidden Gate, before the Gate of Life" — the three elixir fields, yours to train now.

about.zh: 沉鼎观祖师留下的半卷竹简。三百年，没有一个人练成过第一宫——它要五行俱全。开篇是：戴九履一，左三右七。
about.en: Half a bamboo scroll left by the temple's founder. In three hundred years no one has mastered its first palace — it needs all five elements. It opens: nine on the head, one on the feet, three on the left, seven on the right.

about.zh: 柴垛上抽下来的一根柴火棍，一头焦黑。饭桶头一口吃的就是它。
about.en: A stick pulled from the woodpile, one end charred. The very first thing the Rice Bucket ever ate.

hint.en: A pity to burn.

about.en: A dry leaf, so brittle a pinch crumbles it.

hint.en: What falls, falls.

about.zh: 药园拔下来的黄精烂根，一捆，带着泥。周衡账上记了一笔，推给你的。
about.en: A bundle of rotten Solomon's-seal roots pulled from the herb garden, soil still on. Zhou Heng put it in his book and pushed it across to you.

hint.en: Rubbish is accounts too.

about.en: A milkvetch cull from the herb garden, its leaves eaten through by worms.

hint.en: Worm-bitten still counts as one.

about.en: A bamboo toothpick, two rice-grain characters cut into its end: Toothpick; and a smaller line under them.

hint.en: Picked clean, thought through.

about.zh: 一块锅巴，硬得能砸核桃，背面烙着两个字：锅巴；底下一行小字。
about.en: A slab of rice crust hard enough to crack walnuts, two characters burned into its back: Rice Crust; and a line of small print.

hint.en: Better the longer you chew; mind your front teeth.

about.en: A pebble a size smaller than the one that went in, carved: Pebble; and a line of small print.

hint.en: A little smaller than before.

about.en: A twist of straw paper holding a pinch of ash, one character on the paper: Ash; and a line of small print.

hint.en: From where it came, to where it goes.

about.zh: 一颗丹，桂圆大小，通体莹白，托在一方小红纸上，红纸上几个字：含笑半步颠；底下一行小字。
about.en: A pill the size of a longan, pearly white all through, on a square of red paper; on the paper: Smile-and-Stumble; and a line of small print.

hint.en: Take it and smile; flowers bloom at every step.

about.zh: 一颗灰里透红的丹，没有纹，皱巴巴的，裹着一角焦黄的草纸，纸上三个字：止笑丸；底下一行小字。
about.en: A grey-red pill, no rings, wrinkled, wrapped in a corner of scorched straw paper; on it: Stop-Laughing Pill; and a line of small print.

hint.en: Turn back from the sea of bitterness.

about.zh: 一张黄纸，朱砂画的一匹马，四条腿像四根筷子插在一个馒头上。符角一行米粒大的朱字：踏马的符；底下一行更小的。
about.en: A yellow slip, a horse in cinnabar, four legs like four chopsticks stuck in a steamed bun. In the corner, rice-grain red letters: That Damned Horse Charm; and a smaller line under them.

hint.en: Stamp first, ask later.

items._about: Free play's 饭桶 (worlds/jiuding/fantong.json, Hanli 2026-10-15): 银月's running gag (fantong.json events.yinyue): when she touches the bucket, out comes this — 「还不如我给你画」. Not 古四's 踏马符 (tama-fu, a fight card): this one does nothing.

about.en: A qi-gathering pill out of the Rice Bucket, clear and pale, three rings. Two rice-grain characters in the grooves: Gather Qi; and a smaller line.

hint.en: Three rings, no more, no less.

items._about: Free play's 饭桶 (worlds/jiuding/fantong.json, Hanli 2026-10-15): 古七: 隔上好几个月，才蹦出一颗三道四道的 — the rare draw of the 聚气丹 方子. 30 修为 from the task table, between the market one (20) and the nine-turn (60); never sold.

about.zh: 饭桶吐出来的回春丹，三道纹，一股豆腥气，回口一点甜。纹缝里刻着两个字：回春；底下一行小字。
about.en: A mending pill out of the Rice Bucket, three rings, a smell of beans and a sweet aftertaste. In the grooves: Spring Returns; and a line of small print.

hint.en: Bones are harder than mouths.

items.art_source: The 回春丹's picture.

about.zh: 一只百家布拼的口袋，针脚歪歪扭扭，袋口绣着三个字：百纳袋；底下一行小字。
about.en: A pouch patched together from a hundred scraps, crooked stitches, three characters sewn at its mouth: Patchwork Pouch; and a line of small print.

hint.en: If it fits, it is yours.

about.en: The qiuyu's bird beak, ground to a point and wrapped in cloth for a grip. Worn, it lends 木.

about.en: One of the heyu's tusks, longer than a forearm, its edge sharp from birth. Worn, it lends 土.

about.en: A bronze sword buried in a crack of the outer ring, left from some earlier opening of the realm. Under the green rust the edge still shines. Worn, it lends 金.

about.en: The heyu's yellow hide, cured and sewn into a short coat. A blade slides off it.

about.en: A pebble from the dry riverbed, bored and hung at the neck. Its earth is heavy enough to turn a little of an earth spell.

about.en: Stone marrow seeped from a crack of the Cliff of Danger and set into a bead, hung on a cord. Its earth is thick enough to turn an earth spell.

about.en: A piece of green jade from the bottom of the dry river, warm to the touch. Earth and water spells land lighter.

about.zh: 后山赤狐的皮，一身火红，尾巴尖那一点白最值钱。货郎收皮货。
about.en: A red fox's pelt from the back hill, fire-red, the white tail-tip the dearest part. The pedlar buys pelts.

hint.en: Stroke it with the fur.

about.zh: 山狸的皮，灰褐底子一身铜钱斑。小，做不成袄，够做个坎肩。
about.en: A leopard cat's pelt, grey-brown with coin spots. Too small for a coat; enough for a vest.

hint.en: Coin spots, not coins.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 猕猴把野果藏在石窝里忘了吃，日子一久，自己酿成了酒。一股酸甜气，招蜂。
about.en: Wild fruit a macaque hid in a hollow of the rock and forgot; given time, it brewed itself. Sour-sweet, and the bees find it.

hint.en: Saved by monkeys, drunk by men.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 蝮蛇蜕下的一整张皮，薄得透光，连眼睛上那层都在。药铺收，入药。
about.en: A whole skin a pit viper slipped out of, thin enough to see light through, even the scales over the eyes. The apothecary takes it for medicine.

hint.en: Empty, and still the snake.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 蝮蛇的胆，青绿一颗，比指甲盖大一点。明目，苦得要命。
about.en: A pit viper's gall, a green bead a little bigger than a fingernail. Good for the eyes, and bitter as death.

hint.en: The bitter comes after.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 苍鹰翅上的硬翎，一把七八根。装在箭尾，箭飞得直。
about.en: A handful of stiff flight feathers from a goshawk's wing. Fletched on an arrow, it flies straight.

hint.en: Fletch an arrow with it, and the arrow knows the way.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 豺的犬齿，一颗，弯得像个钩。猎户拿红绳穿了挂在脖子上，说是辟邪。
about.en: A dhole's canine, curved like a hook. Hunters string one on red cord and hang it at the neck against ill luck.

hint.en: One. And a pack behind it.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 野猪嘴边往上翻的那一对，磨得锃亮。能雕东西，也能当钱使。
about.en: The upturned pair from a wild boar's jaw, worn bright. You can carve it, or spend it like money.

hint.en: The pair that curl up.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 灰狼的皮，背上一道深色。冬天的狼毛厚，铺在炕上一冬不冷。
about.en: A grey wolf's pelt with a dark stripe down the back. A winter wolf's fur is thick — on a bed, it keeps the cold off all season.

hint.en: Thicker in winter than in summer.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 黑熊的胆，晒干了一小块。药铺论钱收：金黄的叫金胆，最贵；黑的次之。
about.en: A dried bear's gall, a small lump. The apothecary pays by grade: golden is best, black next.

hint.en: Black is dear; gold is dearer.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 从从六只脚上掉下的一只爪子。狗爪的样子，可谁家的狗多长两只脚？
about.en: A claw shed from one of Congcong's six feet. A dog's claw to look at — but whose dog has two feet too many?

hint.en: The one too many.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 絜钩身上的一根灰羽，羽根带着一股病气。画符的人要它——以毒攻毒。
about.en: A grey feather from a Xiegou, a sickly breath about its quill. Talisman-makers want it: poison against poison.

hint.en: Don't sniff it.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 軨軨的一块皮，牛皮的厚，老虎的纹。泡在水里不沉，船家拿它补船。
about.en: A piece of Lingling's hide — as thick as an ox's, striped like a tiger's. It will not sink, and boatmen patch hulls with it.

hint.en: Ox hide, tiger stripes. It floats.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 妴胡掉下的一只眼——圆，亮，像颗珠子。放在掌心里，它好像还在看你。
about.en: An eye shed by a Yuanhu: round and bright as a pearl. In your palm, it seems to be looking back.

hint.en: Like a pearl. Not a pearl.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 精精那条马尾上的长毛，一束，又韧又亮。做拂尘，做弓弦，都使得。
about.en: A hank of long hair from Jingjing's horse tail, tough and glossy. It makes a whisk or a bowstring.

hint.en: Whisk stuff — horsehair.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 獙獙翅上的一根翎，握在手里是热的，像刚从灶边拿出来。
about.en: A feather from Bibi's wing. It is warm in the hand, as if taken from beside the stove.

hint.en: Warm to the touch.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 当康嘴边的一颗小獠牙。老人说挂在粮仓门上，来年仓满。
about.en: A small tusk from Dangkang's jaw. The old folk say hang it on the granary door and next year it will be full.

hint.en: A tooth that brings good news.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 猲狙红脑袋上的一撮鬃毛，红得发亮，不褪色。北号山下的人说它是吃过人的颜色。
about.en: A tuft from Geju's red head, glossy red that never fades. Under Mount Beihao they say it is the colour of what it ate.

hint.en: Red. Not dyed.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 鬿雀的一只爪，老鼠脚上长着虎爪，在石头上一划便是一道白印。
about.en: A Qique's foot — a rat's foot armed with a tiger's claws. Drawn across stone, it leaves a white groove.

hint.en: A tiger's claw on a chicken.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 山里人叫它鸡头参，根像个鸡头。九蒸九晒了，补气，饿的年月也能当饭。
about.en: Hill folk call it chicken-head root for its shape. Steamed and dried nine times it strengthens the breath, and in a lean year it serves as a meal.

hint.en: Steam nine times, dry nine times.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 一块褐色的老根。货郎说长成人形的值千金——见过的人形，多半是人拿刀刻的。
about.en: An old brown root. The pedlar says one grown in a man's shape is worth a fortune — and most he has seen were shaped with a knife.

hint.en: The man-shaped ones are mostly carved by men.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 长在老松根底下的一团菌块，外皮黑褐，里头雪白。松树砍了三四年，底下才结得出来。
about.en: A lump of fungus under an old pine's roots, dark-skinned and snow-white inside. It forms three or four years after the pine is felled.

hint.zh: 长在松根底下，不见天日。
hint.en: Grows under pine roots, never sees the sun.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 一把干根，气味冲。端午前后烧一把，屋里屋外不生虫。
about.en: A bundle of dried roots with a sharp smell. Burn a handful around the Duanwu festival and no vermin breed indoors or out.

hint.en: Burn a handful; no vermin in the house.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 山坡上随手拔的细根草，退热的。名字里有个柴字，却不是柴。
about.en: A thin-rooted herb pulled on any hillside, good against fever. It has 'firewood' in its name, and is not firewood.

hint.en: Firewood in the name; not firewood.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 细根的小草，安神益智。东晋谢安的旧笑话：在山里叫远志，出了山叫小草。
about.en: A small thin-rooted herb that calms the mind. Xie An's old joke: in the hills it is called Far Ambition, out of the hills, Little Grass.

hint.zh: 在山里叫远志，出了山叫小草。
hint.en: In the hills, Far Ambition. Out of them, Little Grass.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 一茎七叶，顶上一朵花，俗名七叶一枝花。蛇咬了，捣烂敷上。
about.en: Seven leaves to a stem and one flower on top — 'seven leaves, one flower'. For a snakebite, pound it and bind it on.

hint.zh: 七叶一枝花，深山是我家。
hint.en: Seven leaves, one flower; the deep hills are my home.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 长在崖壁石缝里的一丛，茎一节一节的像竹子。采它的人，也得挂在崖上。
about.en: A clump growing from a crack in the cliff, its stems jointed like bamboo. Whoever picks it has to hang from the cliff too.

hint.zh: 长在崖上，采的人也挂在崖上。
hint.en: It grows on the cliff, and so must its picker.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 夏天过了一半才冒头的小块茎，白白圆圆。炮制过是药，生的嚼一口，嘴麻半天。
about.en: A small white round tuber that sprouts at midsummer. Prepared, it is medicine; chew it raw and your mouth goes numb half the day.

hint.en: Don't taste it raw.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 松林里雨后冒出来的一窝蘑菇，伞面褐黄。伙房收，炖汤。
about.en: A cluster of mushrooms that come up in the pine wood after rain, brown-yellow caps. The kitchen takes them for soup.

hint.en: Come back after rain.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 溪底淘出来的一捧黑砂，沉手。铁匠收，十捧炼得出一块铁。
about.en: A handful of heavy black sand panned from a stream bed. The smith buys it — ten handfuls smelt one lump of iron.

hint.en: Show it a lodestone and it follows.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 一块薄片叠成的石头，对着光透亮。《神农本草经》说久服轻身——没人敢久服。
about.en: A stone of stacked thin leaves, clear against the light. The Shennong Herbal says long use lightens the body — no one dares the long use.

hint.en: Peel it layer by layer; you never reach the bottom.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 一块黑石头，凑近了铁砂，铁砂便爬上来。磨成勺放在盘上，勺把指南。
about.en: A black stone; bring iron sand near and it climbs on. Ground into a spoon on a plate, the handle points south.

hint.en: It points south — and at iron.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 橘红的一块矿石。端午泡酒，抹在孩子额头上，蛇虫不近。有毒，别吃。
about.en: A lump of orange-red ore. Steeped in wine at Duanwu and daubed on children's brows, it keeps snakes and insects off. Poisonous — don't eat it.

hint.en: Duanwu wine. Snakes don't drink it.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 崖下挖的红土块，摸着滑腻，像抹了油。入药，也拿来封丹炉的缝。
about.en: Lumps of red clay dug under the cliff, slick to the touch as if oiled. Used in medicine — and to seal the seams of a pill furnace.

hint.en: Red earth, slick fingers.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 一张山狸皮缝的坎肩，不知是哪个猎户落在后山的。穿上身轻，夜里走路不出声。
about.en: A vest sewn from a leopard cat's pelt, left on the back hill by some hunter. It is light to wear, and you walk silent in it at night.

hint.en: Wear it at night; make no sound.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 三颗豺牙穿在一根红绳上。猎户说豺怕火也带火，挂着它，火行的法术近身先弱三分。
about.en: Three dhole fangs strung on a red cord. Hunters say the dhole fears fire and carries it; wear this and a fire spell comes at you a little weaker.

hint.en: Hang it at the breast against fire.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by Codex CLI's image tool (gpt-6.1-sol), 2026-10-16, in 水墨淡彩 with art/items/lingzhi.webp and art/items/jade-ring.webp as the style reference, redrawing the 2026-10-15 FLUX picture to the house style. No outside source.

about.zh: 钱掌柜铺子里最贵的一道符：雷落一处，六点，不论五行；一符一用。
about.en: The dearest charm in Money Qian's shop: thunder on one mark, six, whatever the root; one use each.

hint.en: Thunder, once.

about.zh: 一拃来长，柳叶形，剑柄上系一根红丝；扣在指间掐个诀放出去。下品的，练气五层驱得动。
about.en: A hand-span long, willow-leaf shaped, a red thread on the hilt; flicked from the fingers on a sign. Low grade — fifth layer of qi can drive it.

hint.en: A card: the short flying sword.

about.zh: 一枚玉简，贴在额上，三张牌的道理一齐涌进来。
about.en: A jade slip; pressed to the brow, three cards of sense come at once.

hint.en: A card: Contemplation.
